title: Compactness of Toeplitz Operators on the Bergman Space
summary: Let $\varphi\in L^\infty(\D)$. We study compactness criteria for \(T_\varphi\) on the Bergman space $A^2(\D)$. Axler and Zheng~\cite{AZ1998} established a necessary and sufficient condition for compactness in terms of the Berezin transform. For a general bounded measurable function $\varphi$, however, its Berezin transform $\tilde{\varphi}$ does not readily reveal the intrinsic properties of $\varphi$.
